Freaky Frankenstein is an interesting preset that is not the be all and all of presets or RP.

FF is NOT something that will work for everyone or work well with every model. I know it is well liked and I loved FF5 Micro. I personally think a heavy COT restricts a model and I don't mind guiding the model per generation. Rather than using a COT at all, I guide my RP per message or use my own prompt's/presets.

I just don't get this universal, blinded love for freaky Frankenstein - it is a good prompt and greg and his team have done a great job of making a very solid preset but we as users cannot expect it to work with every model or even to work the same with any model on any given day.

I know I'm rambling, all I am really trying to say is that FF should be a starting point for your RP and you should modify it further to suit, not the model, but YOUR preference for RP.

Again I'm not hating I'm just advocating for something that I think dptGreg himself would also advocate for. Do your own thing, take FF5 or Purina or megumin or writers block or evening truth or any other well respected preset and tailor it to your own experience. Or mash them together and make something new!
